# AlmaBetter

> > AlmaBetter accelerates tech careers through industry-certified courses, master's degrees, and placement support from 1200+ hiring partners.

AlmaBetter is a tech education platform offering online degrees and fellowships in Data Science, AI, Web Development, and Cloud Computing with IIT certification and guaranteed job placement. The platform combines rigorous curriculum with mentorship from industry experts and connects graduates with leading employers.

## Key Topics

- Data Science
- Web Development
- Machine Learning
- IIT Certification
- Job Placement
- Career Transformation
- Master's Degree
- Full-Stack Development
- AI
- Cloud Computing
- Industry Mentorship
- Online Learning
- Tech Education
- Placement Support
- IIT Patna

## Featured Degree Programs

- [Masters in Data Science and AI Online (Woolf Uni and IIT)](https://almabetter.com/degrees/masters-in-computer-science-data-science-ai): Master's in Data Science & AI from Woolf University and IIT Patna with industry-recognized credentials
- [Masters in Computer Science from Woolf Univ. & IIT Patna](https://almabetter.com/degrees/masters-in-computer-science-cloud-computing): Master's in Computer Science with cloud computing focus from Woolf University and IIT Patna

## Core Courses & Fellowships

- [Best Online Data Science Course with IIT Certification 2026](https://almabetter.com/courses/full-stack-data-science): Full-stack Data Science course with IIT certification and placement assurance
- [Best Online Data Science Course with IIT Certification 2026](https://almabetter.com/courses/fellowship-full-stack-data-science): Data Science fellowship with IIT certification and ₹5-25 LPA placement outcomes
- [Best Online Software Engineering Course 2026 with IIT Cert.](https://almabetter.com/courses/full-stack-web-development): Full-stack web development course with IBM/Microsoft certification
- [Best Online Software Engineering Course 2026 with IIT Cert.](https://almabetter.com/courses/fellowship-full-stack-web-development): Software Engineering fellowship with IIT certification and guaranteed job placement
